aggregate_runner.execution_boundary: For each governed predicate, the members are read from the reviewed maps in the test classes that own them (criteria map bullet, or a reviewed map bound to its authority sentence) and each item names exactly one executing guard. Every distinct guard is executed by the real PHPUnit as its own process (one test class per invocation, classes in parallel), reading the junit outcome per method. A member counts only if PASSED with at least one assertion. The authority binding of each map is executed with it. The predicate verdict is computed from its own items only; the parent verdict is green only when every predicate is.
aggregate_runner.not_a_synthetic_substitute: The runner contains no copy of any behaviour it aggregates and stubs no member: the members are the existing production-path guards, run unmodified in their own classes.
aggregate_runner.first_control_run_defect: The first control run reported GOVERNED_PREDICATE_NOT_DECLARED:MD-S050-R0017 because the governed set was parsed from every finding; fixed to the F-017 section before any proof was taken. That run is retained in the working data only as a runner-development observation.
